name: Kerur Holdings Ltd.
summary: Kerur Holdings Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates in the food sector in Israel. It produces and markets beverages, including soft drinks, soda, mineral water, and alcoholic beverages; production and marketing of potato chips and other frozen-shaped vegetable products; and plant products. It sells and distributes its products under Tapozina, Spring, RC, Spring Tea Cola, Schweppes Fun Water, Schweppes, Crystal, Ein Gedi, and Fruit & Veg brands. The company was incorporated in 1929 and is based in Or Yehuda, Israel. Kerur Holdings Ltd. is a subsidiary of Israel Lighterage & Supply Co. Ltd.
